color.note: Brand colours are fixed in both themes. Ivory is the letter and the app; Bordeaux is the invitation's cover, reply band and footer. Forms always sit on Ivory, even inside a Bordeaux band.

tokens.name: brand-burgundy
tokens.usage: Confirmed primary brand colour. Identity: the cover, display type and headings on light grounds, the primary action. 14.39:1 on ivory.

tokens.name: brand-gold
tokens.usage: Confirmed accent. On light grounds ornament only (hairlines, the arch frame, lozenges): 2.20:1 on ivory fails as text. On brand-burgundy it is text: 6.55:1.

tokens.name: brand-taupe
tokens.usage: Confirmed additional accent. On light grounds ornament only (2.27:1 on ivory). On brand-burgundy, secondary text and control edges: 6.34:1.

tokens.name: brand-blush
tokens.usage: The logo's wordmark colour, seen in the supplied file and awaiting the designer's confirmation. Headings and the primary action on brand-burgundy: 13.51:1.

tokens.name: ivory
tokens.usage: Recommended. The page ground of the letter and the app.

tokens.name: porcelain
tokens.usage: Recommended. Cards, the personal card and every form surface.

tokens.name: linen
tokens.usage: Recommended. Alternate bands, wells and hover grounds. Every Ivory text role still reaches AA on it.

tokens.name: sand
tokens.usage: Recommended. Decorative separators, disabled fills and the champagne cover. Never text.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Recommended. Running text on ivory (16.45:1), porcelain (17.16:1) and linen (15.01:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Recommended. Secondary and helper text on ivory (5.97:1), porcelain (6.23:1) and linen (5.44:1).

tokens.name: gold-ink
tokens.usage: Recommended. Gold as text on light grounds, for eyebrow labels: 5.44:1 on ivory, 5.68:1 on porcelain, 4.97:1 on linen.

tokens.name: taupe-ink
tokens.usage: Recommended. Taupe as text on light grounds: 5.51:1 on ivory.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Recommended. Edges of inputs, chips and outlined buttons on light grounds: 3.85:1 on ivory, 4.02:1 on porcelain, 3.51:1 on linen.

tokens.name: burgundy-hover
tokens.usage: Recommended. Primary action on hover; ivory text on it reaches 12.10:1.

tokens.name: burgundy-deep
tokens.usage: Recommended. Primary action when pressed, and deep bands; ivory text on it reaches 16.39:1.

tokens.name: burgundy-raised
tokens.usage: Recommended. A raised surface on brand-burgundy; ivory text 12.51:1, brand-gold 5.69:1, brand-taupe 5.51:1.

tokens.name: selected-tint
tokens.usage: Recommended. The ground of a selected choice on light surfaces; ink 14.58:1, brand-burgundy 12.76:1.

tokens.name: error-ink
tokens.usage: Recommended. Error text, icons and edges on ivory (6.85:1) and porcelain (7.14:1). Always with an icon and words.

tokens.name: error-ink-hover
tokens.usage: Recommended. Error links on hover: 9.50:1 on ivory, 9.91:1 on porcelain, 8.97:1 on error-tint.

tokens.name: error-tint
tokens.usage: Recommended. The ground of the error summary; error-ink on it reaches 6.47:1.

tokens.name: success-ink
tokens.usage: Recommended. Success text and icons on ivory (5.94:1) and porcelain (6.20:1).

tokens.name: success-tint
tokens.usage: Recommended. The ground of the reply confirmation; success-ink on it reaches 5.70:1.

tokens.name: error-on-dark
tokens.usage: Recommended. Error text on brand-burgundy, rarely needed: 9.05:1.

tokens.name: success-on-dark
tokens.usage: Recommended. Success text on brand-burgundy: 10.57:1.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: The ground of a section.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards on the section ground.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Alternate bands and wells; the hover ground of secondary buttons.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Running text on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken, in both themes (lowest pair 12.51:1).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken, in both themes (lowest pair 5.44:1).

tokens.name: heading
tokens.usage: Display type and headings on surface and surface-raised, in both themes (lowest pair 11.74:1).

tokens.name: label
tokens.usage: Eyebrow labels on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken, in both themes (lowest pair 4.97:1).

tokens.name: ornament
tokens.usage: Hairline rules, lozenges and the arch frame, in both themes. Decorative only; never text or a control edge.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Separators between list rows and card edges that carry no meaning. Decorative.

tokens.name: control-edge
tokens.usage: Edges of inputs, chips, choice cards and outlined buttons, at least 3:1 on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: The primary button's fill, the secondary button's edge and text, links.

tokens.name: action-text
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an action fill (14.39:1 Ivory, 13.51:1 Bordeaux).

tokens.name: action-hover
tokens.usage: The primary button on hover; action-text stays legible (12.10:1 Ivory, 6.55:1 Bordeaux).

tokens.name: action-pressed
tokens.usage: The primary button while pressed (16.39:1 Ivory, 6.34:1 Bordeaux).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The focus ring: 2px solid, offset 2px, on every interactive element. At least 11.74:1 on every surface it lands on.

tokens.name: selected
tokens.usage: The ground behind a selected choice card.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Error text, icons and field edges, always with words and an icon.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text and icons.

families.serif: "Noto Serif Armenian", "Noto Serif", Sylfaen, Georgia, serif

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Noto Serif Armenian for Armenian, Noto Serif for Latin and Cyrillic. Light weights at large sizes. Sizes are the phone values; desktop values are in each usage note.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The hosts' names on the invitation cover. 80/84px from 1024px wide. Letter-spacing 0 in Armenian.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: The reply confirmation and the not-found page. 56/62px on desktop.

styles.name: numeral-l
styles.usage: Countdown digits. Digits are tabular by default, so nothing shifts. 64/64px on desktop.

styles.name: heading-2
styles.usage: Card titles such as venue names, and the personal greeting. 28/34px on desktop.

styles.name: heading-3
styles.usage: Question legends in the reply form. 20/26px on desktop.

styles.name: numeral-m
styles.usage: Times in the timeline. 22/26px on desktop.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Noto Sans Armenian for Armenian, Noto Sans for Latin and Cyrillic. Armenian body text takes line-height 1.7.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: We would be glad to share this important day with you.
styles.usage: The first paragraph of the invitation's story. 20/32px on desktop.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Ուրախ կլինենք Ձեզ հետ կիսել մեր կյանքի այս կարևոր օրը։

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Вы можете изменить ответ по этой ссылке, пока приём ответов открыт.
styles.usage: Helper text and captions under fields.

groups.name: Labels
groups.note: Capitals in all three scripts. Tracking is halved for Armenian, pending a native reader's review.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Small labels above headings, in label colour. Set in capitals with text-transform. Armenian letter-spacing 0.08em. 13/18px on desktop.

styles.name: button-text
styles.usage: Button labels, in capitals. Armenian letter-spacing 0.06em.

styles.name: field-text
styles.usage: Text typed into fields. Never below 16px: smaller makes iOS zoom on focus.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between an icon and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside controls; the gap between the arch and its gold hairline.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between an eyebrow and its heading; between choice cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gutters below 360px; padding inside small controls.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Phone gutters.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between a heading and its content; between form fields; card padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; gutters from 640px; the personal card's overlap of the cover.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gutters from 768px.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Large gaps inside a section.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Between sections on phones; gutters from 1024px.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Between major sections on phones.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Between sections on desktop.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Between major sections on desktop.

radius.note: Square by default. The arch is the one curve.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, fields, chips and images.

tokens.name: radius-hair
tokens.usage: The corners of the focus ring only.

tokens.name: radius-arch
tokens.usage: The top corners of the arch frame only, which makes a semicircle of the frame's width.

shadow.note: Hairlines do the work; shadows only lift floating parts.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: The sticky reply bar and the floating music control.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: The personal card where it overlaps the cover.

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: Large phones: 32px gutters, a 36rem column.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Tablets: 40px gutters, a 40rem column, venue cards in pairs.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: The open card: the cover pinned on the left 5/12, the letter on the right 7/12.

tokens.name: bp-xl
tokens.usage: Desktops.

tokens.name: bp-2xl
tokens.usage: Content stops growing.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: The longest line of running text, about 65 characters.

tokens.name: column-open
tokens.usage: The letter column in the open card.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: The smallest touch target, both ways.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Primary buttons and text fields.

tokens.name: focus-width
tokens.usage: The focus ring's width; offset by the same.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: Separators, card edges, control edges, the arch frame.

tokens.name: icon-size
tokens.usage: Lucide line icons in text and controls, 1.5px stroke. 24px when alone.
